items.quote: Where the Report is about a Respondent who is a Student, the Student Conduct Policy (S 10.05) will apply and the Office of Student Support, Rights and Responsibilities will respond to the Report in accordance with the processes and procedures under the Student Conduct Policy (S 10.05).
items.reason: Reports against students are directed to and handled under the general Student Conduct Policy.

items.quote: A Survivor who has experienced Sexualized Violence by another member of the University Community may choose to Report the Sexualized Violence to the Sexual Violence Support and Prevention Office with the intention of initiating a process under section 8.5 of this policy.
items.reason: The policy directs survivors to report to the Sexual Violence Support and Prevention Office but does not provide specific contact details or concrete steps on how to reach them.
The policy does not address the complainant's past sexual history.
The policy does not guarantee protection from face-to-face contact or direct cross-examination during the process.
The policy does not address the right of complainants to speak about their experience or prohibit non-disclosure agreements.

items.reason: The policy explicitly guarantees the survivor's right to make autonomous decisions about which options to pursue, if any.
The policy does not mention amnesty for drug or alcohol use at the time of reporting.

items.quote: The University shall deal with all Reports of Sexualized Violence in a fair, unbiased, and timely manner and in accordance with relevant collective agreements and other applicable University policies.
items.reason: Timelines are described using vague terms like 'timely' rather than specific, binding day limits.

items.quote: The University will provide a Complainant who initiates a process under section 8.5.2 with the outcome of the Report that was made.
